lead_fa: Elemental Shaman کست‌برِ ranged با سه مکتب Nature و Fire و Frost است که با [[Maelstrom]] کار می‌کند: اسپل‌هایت تقریباً همه قابلیت [[Mastery: Elemental Overload]] دارند و یک بار دیگر به‌طور خودکار کست می‌شوند. بازی حول یک لیست اولویت سخت می‌چرخد: هدر ندادن [[Maelstrom]]]] و همیشه در حال کست‌بودن. دو مسیر Hero Tree داری: [[Farseer]] با ارتش [[Ancestors]] که با تنظیم فعلی در همهٔ محتواها بهتر است، و [[Stormbringer]] با [[Tempest]] و آذرخش‌ها.

strengths: Incredible burst via Ascendance, especially in AoE
Shamans bring many types of utility and are often called the Swiss Army Knife of classes
Simple yet satisfying playstyle with an easy skill floor and room for skill expression
Some of the best visual effects in the game
weaknesses: Lacking mobility in raids: minimizing movement is a big part of playing the spec well
Lacks some defensive capabilities compared to other classes, especially impactful in Mythic+

buffs: Power of the Maelstrom redesigned: Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning have a 15% chance to cause the next Lava Burst to deal 20% increased damage, stacking up to 2 times; Lava Burst consumes one stack at a time
Farseer: Ancestors' Chain Lightning now hits up to 5 targets (was 3)
Farseer: Ancestors' Lava Burst now also increases damage by a percent equal to your critical strike chance
Supercharge redesigned: Lightning Bolt, Chain Lightning and Tempest overloads deal 10% additional damage
nerfs: Ascendance now increases the damage of Mastery: Elemental Overload by 30% (was 75%)
Bonus Lava Bursts when activating Ascendance are now 50% of their normal value (was 100%)
Molten Wrath now increases Lava Burst damage by 10% (was 15%)
Apex Feedback Loop (Rank 1) now increases Mastery: Elemental Overload damage by 10% (was 35%) and also increases Elemental damage done by 10%
Apex Feedback Loop (Rank 2) now grants 15%/30% critical damage bonus (was 25%/50%)
Elemental Blast casts from Fusion of Elements only grant 40% of the normal duration of the stat buffs (was 100%)
Ancestors' Lava Burst damage reduced by 20%
Stormkeeper no longer guarantees Lightning Bolt to trigger Mastery: Elemental Overload
changes_12_1.note: Wowhead Elemental guide updated 2026-10-13 for Midnight Season 2.

hero.recommendation: Farseer is currently the better choice in all PvE or PvP content, offering easier gameplay, better defensive capabilities and better consistent damage output; the talent page carries the Best tags for Raid, Mythic+ and Delves on Farseer. With the numerous nerfs to overloads, Stormbringer struggles to find its synergies and relying on the flat damage from the Ancestors works out better.
hero.farseer: Summons an army of pets in the form of Ancestors which mirror your spells by casting their own Lava Bursts or Chain Lightnings; Ancestors' Chain Lightning hits up to 5 targets after 12.1.
hero.stormbringer: Relies on the power of the storm, calling down the mighty Tempest on enemies and focusing on lightning abilities.
hero.comparison_source_note: Wowhead overview and talent page (HawkCorrigan, updated 2026-10-13): Farseer best in all content with Best tags on all three modes.

concepts: Avoid Maelstrom waste: the resource enables spenders like Earthquake, Earth Shock and Elemental Blast, so waste as little as possible
Always Be Casting: Elemental lacks mobility tools, so minimize movement, use Nature's Swiftness and Spiritwalker's Grace for forced movement, and ask for externals like Time Spiral
React to procs: sync cooldowns and pool Maelstrom or Tempest procs around Ascendance; spend Lava Surge procs on Master of the Elements windows for your highest damage spells like Tempest
Elemental operates on a strict priority list rather than a traditional resource system: each GCD go top to bottom and press the highest value button
st_priority: Remember to use Spiritwalker's Grace and Nature's Swiftness for movement events
Cast Ascendance roughly on cooldown, but always after Stormkeeper
Cast Elemental Blast if you have Overcharge! (Tier Set) active
Cast Elemental Blast if you are within 15 points of your Maelstrom cap
Cast Elemental Blast if you have Master of the Elements active
Cast Lava Burst if you do not have Master of the Elements active
Cast Lightning Bolt to consume Master of the Elements
Refresh Flame Shock with Voltaic Blaze within the pandemic window (30% of its current maximum duration) if you do not have Master of the Elements active
Cast Lightning Bolt as your filler
aoe_priority: Remember to use Spiritwalker's Grace and Nature's Swiftness for movement events
Cast Ancestral Swiftness roughly on cooldown
Cast Ascendance roughly on cooldown, but always after Stormkeeper
Cast Earthquake against 3 or more targets if possible
Cast Elemental Blast against 2 targets, if possible
Cast Lava Burst if you have Lava Surge and Purging Flames active (this should line up naturally)
Cast Chain Lightning as your filler
rotation.aoe_note: There is very little overlap between single target and AoE: AoE starts at 2 targets where Lightning Bolt is replaced with Chain Lightning; the spender breakpoint depends on talents (Earthquake at 3+ targets, Elemental Blast at 2 targets).

cooldowns.Stormkeeper: Main short cooldown: the next 2 Lightning Bolts deal 150% increased damage and trigger one additional overload; Chain Lightning triggers an additional overload on every target hit; sync with Ascendance which buffs the resulting overloads; for Farseer it also spawns an Ancestor
cooldowns.Ascendance: Casts Flame Shock on up to 6 enemies in combat range; makes all spells that can overload do so exactly one additional time and buffs overloads (12.1 reduced the overload damage bonus to 30%); with Call of Fire it spawns a Fire Elemental that buffs Flame Shock duration and tick rate, so cast another Flame Shock near the end; use overload-triggering spells like Stormkeeper (and Voltaic Blaze in AoE) before it

rotation.hero_notes: Farseer AoE relies on the Ancestors spawned by Stormkeeper and Ancestral Swiftness: they mirror your casts, sending Lava Burst for single-target spells and Chain Lightning for AoE spells; overloads are ignored by them except spells that apply Flame Shock. The burst window is Stormkeeper, then Ancestral Swiftness, then Voltaic Blaze, then Ascendance, with Voltaic Blaze cast outside the Ascendance window.
pre_combat: Apply the Flametongue Weapon imbue if you are running the Flametongue Weapon talent (automatic when casting Lightning Shield with Instinctive Imbuements)
Use Skyfury to buff yourself and your group

gear.gearing_rules: Rough guideline: Mastery > Haste = Critical Strike >> Versatility. Don't neglect Intellect: a substantial item level increase is generally worth it compared to optimized stats. Get Mastery to the first breakpoint at 72% (about 1200 rating), then split the rest between Critical Strike and Haste; avoid Versatility where possible (some is unavoidable on tier pieces). Mastery is pretty much useless after 100% since overloads are capped: with Elemental Blast: Mastery the usual hardcap is around 86%, dropping to roughly 76% with the Root Warden's Regalia embellishment set. Critical Strike became significantly better in Midnight (Feedback Loop stacking and Lava Burst scaling with crit chance) and has caught up with Haste in single target. Sim with Raidbots.

stats.cheatsheet: Mastery to the first breakpoint at 72% (~1200 rating), then split the rest between Critical Strike and Haste; avoid Versatility where possible. Identical for Farseer and Stormbringer.
notes: Mastery is pretty much useless after 100%: overloads are capped at 100% and with Elemental Blast: Mastery the usual hardcap is around 86% (roughly 76% with Root Warden's Regalia).

mplus.hero_note: Farseer is the Best-tagged hero for Mythic+ this season: the Ancestors' Chain Lightning hitting 5 targets after 12.1 makes their flat damage valid for AoE, while Stormbringer struggles after the overload nerfs. AoE starts at 2 targets with Chain Lightning replacing Lightning Bolt.
tips: Cast Earthquake against 3 or more targets and Elemental Blast against 2 targets
Line up Stormkeeper, Ancestral Swiftness, Voltaic Blaze and Ascendance as your burst window
Keep Flame Shock up with Voltaic Blaze refreshes inside the pandemic window
Use Spiritwalker's Grace and Nature's Swiftness for forced movement so you never stop casting
Spend Lava Surge procs through Master of the Elements on your highest damage spells like Tempest
